name: Ross Latta
headline: Partner at Cooper Parry Digital | Head of NetSuite Practice | Founder and CEO (exited)
position: Partner at Cooper Parry Digital & Head of NetSuite Practice
about:
MacroFin is the leading NetSuite implementation partner in the UK and Europe, and we are fundamentally changing the way ERP implementations are carried out. Fast-growing businesses across tech, software, wholesale distribution, hospitality and beyond are choosing to work with us because our approach is proven to get the results they want, and fast. 

As a Chartered Accountant myself, I co-founded MacroFin in 2018 with a deliberate, unique finance-led approach from the outset, and we have strategically developed a team that eliminates the common pitfalls of ERP implementations for our customers. With an typical go-live time of just 4 months and 300+ NetSuite projects successfully completed, we have helped some of Europe's biggest brands such as PensionBee, Motorway, and Bloom & Wild to revolutionise their finance systems. 

MacroFin is distinct from other partners, because finance professionals with client-side implementation experience form the core of our consultancy team. They’ve been in your shoes and know that finance and accounting experience is key to a successful implementation. 

 + We can support you from the very beginning of your ERP review journey. Our pre-ERP consulting team can help you to capture your processes and requirements, perform a system gap analysis and advise on the optimal set up and specification for your needs. 

+ We work closely with NetSuite as an Alliance Partner because we believe it is the best finance and ERP tool on the market to achieve process excellence in growing businesses. 
 
+ We provide optimisation services for clients already using NetSuite to ensure maximum value is extracted from the system by automating processes, enhancing reporting, integrating with internal systems and training staff. 
 
+ MacroFin’s certified NetSuite and SuiteSuccess consultants and qualified accountants possess a unique mix of strong IT and finance expertise. 
 
+ We have a deep knowledge of systems, business operations and finance processes. We know what works and what doesn’t. 
 
+ We deliver agile, cost-effective on-site implementations. 
 
+ Our mission is to help empower your growing business, and we have a strong focus on customer success and long-term relationships.
… more

experiences.companyName: Warner Bros. TV Production UK Limited
experiences.description:
Shed Media Group is a leading producer and distributor of television audio visual content with 43 subsidiaries across the UK and in Los Angeles. Shed Media Group is a subsidiary of Warner Bros. Entertainment Company.

• Key member on the project team which delivered the successful migration of a group of 43 entities on to the Warner Bros SAP accounting system, which had a successful go-live on 1 Jan 2013.
• Created and presented in-house training and provided on-going support to staff post-implementation to ensure buy-in from staff affected by changes.
• Designed an excel based interfaces and reporting template between legacy production cost system and SAP that reduced data transfer process at month end from 3 days to half a day.
• Business partner the television production team with full P&L control for a defined cluster of subsidiaries; managing all reporting, forecasting and analysis requirements.
• Corporate tax and transfer pricing between international companies within the group.

Monitor is an independent National Health Service regulatory organisation which monitors, reports on and intervenes where necessary in the financial, operation and governance of NHS Hospitals.

My role as a Compliance Manager allowed me to develop my business analytical, commercial and operational assessment skills. My primary responsibilities were to: 

• Review, evaluate and present to management on the financial and operational performance of NHS organisations with turnover of up to ₤500m pa with a focus on identifying key issues affecting Quality of Care 
• Conduct financial analysis on short to medium term financial viability, identifying key risk areas and assessing sensitivities
• Conduct industry-wide analysis on forecast capital expenditure of  ₤1.4b and presented to Monitor board, successfully responding to queries raised
